subject: [PATCH v2 06/11] nfsd: pin the client while a GETATTR holds a conflicting delegation

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug where the NFS server could crash when handling GETATTR requests that conflict with write delegations. The issue arises because the client reference is not held while the lease is still on the inode, allowing the client to be destroyed before the GETATTR request completes. To fix this, the patch introduces two new functions: nfsd4_get_leased_deleg and nfsd4_put_leased_deleg. These functions take a reference on both the delegation and the client, ensuring that the client remains alive while the lease is still on the inode. The patch also updates the existing code to use these new functions when handling GETATTR conflicts with write delegations.
